decisions.reason: The full-app scope decision also applies to Android, but a complete same-message MODIFY already records the FULL_APP_CONTENT context, so no additional or edited Event is needed.
Full-app localization does not change the existing requirement to render RTL locales correctly.
Expanding localization to full app content does not alter the stated iOS size-optimization requirement.
The localization scope decision does not change iOS framework modernization, deprecated-API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
The requirement for an iOS Privacy Manifest is unaffected by whether localization covers the full app.
The full-app localization decision does not change the need for valid iOS signing configuration.
The localization scope decision does not modify the Android application-size optimization goal or its distribution scope.
Full-app localization does not change Android platform compatibility, deprecated-API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
The localization scope decision has no effect on the policy to remove unused Android permissions or the identified READ_PHONE_STATE permission.
The decision to localize the full app does not resolve whether the separate Youku integration should be retained, repaired, or removed.
Full-app localization does not change the existing strategy of serving tutorial and graphics-heavy content remotely rather than bundling it in the apps.
